Tipping Study - pt.3 Clean up trial data
---

```{r Setup workspace}
if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)
```

```{r Load data}
load(here::here("data", "proc", "02_out.rdata"))
```

 Exclusion/inclusion criteria/checks
---


> First exclusions based off % of trials w/ marker flatlining.
> Simplifying checks to the primary movement axis, Z (for/back-ward),
> by finding maximum distance reached.

>[!Important]
> Loss of over 30% of trials, when broken down by effector hand and side, was grounds for exclusion.

```{r Get distance travelled}
zs <- dt[,
  .(slope = round(diff(range(hand_z)), digits = 2)),
  by = .(
    participant_id,
    trial_num,
    left_right_hand,
    palm_back_hand,
    target_loc,
    distractor_loc
  )
]

flatlines <- zs[
  ,
  .(
    flats = nrow(.SD[slope < 1]),
    prop = round(nrow(.SD[slope < 1]) / .N, digits = 2)
  ),
  by = .(participant_id, left_right_hand, palm_back_hand)
]

summary(flatlines$prop)
pclid(flatlines$prop)
nrow(flatlines[prop > .3])

ss_to_keep <- droplevels(flatlines[prop <= 0.3, unique(participant_id)])
```

> [!Note]
> Target objects were placed ~35 cm anterior to Ss.
> But there is a fair amount of noise in the data.
>
> So, we'll consider any slope > 20 cm as a good trial, and reassess later.
>
> A rule was chosen that any Ss would be exluded wholesale if over 50%
> of reaches flatlined when using either effector side.

> [!Important]
> For now, hand used not taken into account. Later, lateral movements
> made with one's left-hand will be mirrored and pooled with right-hand movements.

```{r Flatlining by hand-side}
ss_to_keep <- dt[
  # Restrict to good Ss
  participant_id %in% ss_to_keep,
  .(
    # Get max z-pos
    slope = max(hand_z)
  ),
  # For each trial, hand-handside combo
  by = .(participant_id, trial_num, palm_back_hand, left_right_hand)
] |>
  # Of these
  _[,
    .(
      # Summarize occurances of flatlining
      shorts = nrow(.SD[slope < 20]),
      prop = nrow(.SD[slope < 20]) / .N
    ),
    # By Ss and handside; ignoring hand used
    by = .(participant_id, palm_back_hand)
  ] |>
  # of these
  _[
    # Find Ss with at most 50% flatlining
    prop <= 0.5, unique(participant_id)
  ] |>
  # Drop levels corresponding to Ss who did not pass checks
  droplevels(x = _)
```

> Of the remaining Ss, trial data is screen for flatlining, but now
> subsetted by within-block factors (target & distractor loc).
> A similar threshold of 50% was applied.

```{r Flatlining by objects' location}
# effectively repeats the above, but different grouping factors
shorts <- dt[
  participant_id %in% ss_to_keep,
  .(slope = max(hand_z)),
  by = .(participant_id, trial_num, target_loc, distractor_loc)
] |>
  _[,
    .(
      shorts = nrow(.SD[slope < 20]),
      prop = nrow(.SD[slope < 20]) / .N
    ),
    by = .(participant_id, target_loc, distractor_loc)
  ]

ss_to_keep <- shorts[
  prop <= 0.5, unique(participant_id)
]

length(ss_to_keep) # Still 19
```

> Okay, so let's backpedal a bit, and see, how many Ss would be lost from ss_to_keep
> if we additionally require that data is available for each hand*side combo.

```{r}
ss_to_drop <- flatlines[
  participant_id %in% ss_to_keep &
    prop > 0.5,
  unique(participant_id)
]

ss_to_keep <- setdiff(ss_to_keep, ss_to_drop)
length(ss_to_keep) # 13
```

```{r}
dt <- dt[participant_id %in% ss_to_keep]

avg_slopes <- dt[,
  .(
    slope = max(hand_z)
  ),
  by = .(
    participant_id, trial_num,
    palm_back_hand, left_right_hand,
    target_loc, distractor_loc
  )
] |> _[,
  .(
    avg_sl = mean(slope),
    med_sl = median(slope),
    max_sl = max(slope),
    min_sl = min(slope)
  ),
  by = .(
    participant_id,
    palm_back_hand, left_right_hand,
    target_loc, distractor_loc
  )
]

pclih(avg_slopes$avg_sl)
summary(avg_slopes$avg_sl)
```

Get trials wherein the max z-pos does not reach 20 cm

```{r}
drop_trials <- dt[,
  .(drop = max(hand_z) < 20),
  by = .(participant_id, trial_num, block_num)
] |> _[drop == TRUE]
```

Use anti-join to drop corresponding rows from dt.

```{r}
dt <- dt[
  !drop_trials,
  on = .(participant_id, trial_num, block_num)
]
```

That's a wrap on cleaning for now.

```{r}
save(dt, file = here::here("data", "proc", "03_out.rdata"))
fwrite(dt, file = here::here("data", "scratch", "03_out.csv"))
```
